Never edit /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself. Do NOT git commit and do NOT touch .git. No network calls, no billed runs, no Playwright browser runs.

OWNED FILES: frontend/e2e/blind-player.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.test.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js, frontend/e2e/helpers.js.

BACKGROUND: A turn can end in a 'game break': the API turn payload carries `game_break` ({warning_id, reason}) and `state.pending_game_break: true`; the page shows #game-break-panel (#game-break-reason text, buttons 'Return to scene' and 'Proceed'). The player's choice POSTs /api/v1/game-break with decision 'proceed' or 'return_to_scene'; 'return_to_scene' rolls back to before the consequence, 'proceed' commits it (possibly destroying a future dependency). Today frontend/e2e/helpers.js resolveWarningIfPresent(page) silently clicks 'Return to scene' if the panel is visible, and the blind-player harness (blind-player.spec.js playScene, which calls it after every successful submitTurn) records nothing about it and has no policy. A panel that fails to resolve would surface only as a generic Playwright timeout that looks like a story stall.

CHANGES:
1. Explicit choice policy. In blind-player.js add a small pure function (e.g. gameBreakPolicy(env)) reading BLIND_PLAYER_BREAK_POLICY: 'return' (default; the non-destructive choice, same behavior as today), 'proceed'. Any other value throws a clear error (no silent fallback). Document the policy in the module comment and, if the file has a README-style usage comment, there.
2. Handling and recording. Add an exported async function (e.g. handleGameBreak(page, payload, {policy, timeoutMs})) in blind-player.js or helpers.js (your choice; keep it testable with a fake page object exposing locator(...).isVisible()/textContent()/click() and the expectations you use, no real browser). It must: detect a pending break from payload.game_break OR the visible panel; read the reason from #game-break-reason; click the button for the policy; wait for the panel to hide with a bounded timeout; and RETURN a record: {warning_id, reason, policy, decision, outcome} where outcome is one of 'returned', 'proceeded', or 'timeout' (panel still visible after the bound, or click failed). Never throw on a panel timeout; return outcome 'timeout' and keep the evidence. Preserve pending-state/rollback evidence in the record: before = {scene_id, turn_index?, pending_game_break} from payload.state (use only fields that exist; do not invent), after = same fields from the status line / next payload if available, else null. Keep resolveWarningIfPresent exported and working for other callers (scene-walk etc.) -- you may reimplement it on top of the new function but its boolean contract must hold.
3. Turn records and analysis. blind-player.spec.js playScene must use the new handler, attach `game_break` (the record or null) to that turn's record, and if the outcome is 'timeout' stop the scene loop with an explicit marker (e.g. stopped_on_game_break_timeout: true) instead of continuing. turnRecord/turnLog in blind-player.js must carry `game_break` through (null when none). analyseRun and aggregate must report SEPARATE counts: game_break_count, game_break_returned_count, game_break_proceeded_count, game_break_timeout_count, and the aggregate rate fields analogous to rejected_turn_rate; a turn with a game break must NOT be counted as stuck, rejected, or a story stall because of the break, and a timeout must not be added to stuck_turns/stuck_runs. Make sure aggregateByScene and any merge code under frontend/e2e/merge-blind-player.js is not broken (read it; if it enumerates aggregate keys, tell me in your notes rather than editing it -- it is NOT yours).
4. Tests in blind-player.test.js (node:test, existing style): policy parsing (default, 'proceed', invalid throws); handler with a fake page for returned, proceeded and timeout outcomes; turnRecord/turnLog carry game_break; analyseRun/aggregate count the three outcomes separately and leave stuck counts untouched; existing tests still pass (update an expectation only if a new always-present key forces it).

HOW TO RUN: from the worktree run `ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules` if it is missing (it is gitignored), then `cd frontend && node --test e2e/blind-player.test.js e2e/merge-blind-player.test.js e2e/scene-walk.test.js e2e/package-clock-controller.test.js && node --check e2e/blind-player.spec.js e2e/helpers.js`. Match the surrounding style and comment density. Write short notes (what changed, anything outside your files that needs attention) to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-notes/game-break-notes.md.
